entities.summary:
Anna Lühring (1796-08-03, Bremen - 1866-08-25) was a soldier in the Prussian army during the Napoleonic Wars.

    Lühring fought in the Battle of Waterloo, where she distinguished herself for bravery, earning her a place in the records of the Prussian military.

    Her actions during the war have been remembered as a testament to the determination of women in the face of adversity, inspiring generations to come.

    Today, Anna Lühring's legacy serves as a reminder of the crucial role that ordinary individuals played in shaping the course of world history.
